global.title: DRC Ebola outbreak expands across 57 health zones in 6 provinces
global.summary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 70 new confirmed Ebola cases in the last 24 hours, including 16 community deaths, as the outbreak continues to spread beyond its epicenter in Ituri.
global.whyItMatters: A growing health crisis invites prayer, compassion, and awareness for vulnerable communities and overstretched caregivers.

global.title: UNRWA training center seized near East Jerusalem amid fresh tensions
global.summary: Israel announced the seizure of the Qalandia Training Center of UNRWA north of occupied East Jerusalem, prompting Palestinian calls for urgent U.N. Security Council action.
global.whyItMatters: This affects already fragile humanitarian work in the Holy Land and may shape how pastors pray and speak about justice, peace, and aid access.

global.title: UN warns drone attacks are increasingly threatening civilians and aid work in Ukraine
global.summary: A senior U.N. humanitarian official said the intensifying use of drones against civilians and relief workers in Ukraine is becoming a serious obstacle to aid operations.
global.whyItMatters: It highlights the deepening human cost of war and offers a timely lens for praying for peacemaking, protection, and endurance.

canadian.title: Canadian prime minister suspends trade talks with U.S., setting new 50% tariffs in motion
canadian.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney suspended trade negotiations with the United States after late talks failed, triggering steep new tariffs at midnight.
canadian.whyItMatters: This has direct implications for affordability, employment, and congregational stress across Canada, including families in Kris's church.

canadian.title: Canada unveils retaliatory tariffs against US as trade war deepens
canadian.summary: Canada announced $27.6 billion in retaliatory tariffs and $7.5 billion in support for affected businesses and workers as the trade conflict escalates.
canadian.whyItMatters: Pastors may see rising anxiety among business owners and workers, making this important context for care, prayer, and practical support.

canadian.title: Montreal City Council passes watered-down Palestine solidarity resolution
canadian.summary: Montreal City Council approved a revised Palestine solidarity motion after removing stronger language that would have suspended ties with Israel and formally used terms like genocide and apartheid.
canadian.whyItMatters: This reflects how the Israel-Palestine conflict is shaping civic life in Canada and may surface in pastoral conversations within diverse congregations.

local.title: Heart to heart – August 24, 2026 - Fraser Health
local.summary: Fraser Health shared fresh public gratitude for staff at Abbotsford Regional Hospital and Cancer Centre and Chilliwack General Hospital, highlighting compassionate care across the region.
local.whyItMatters: It is a meaningful reminder to encourage and pray for local health workers who carry heavy emotional and physical loads.

local.title: The UFV researcher who cured her own chronic pain
local.summary: A University of the Fraser Valley researcher’s work on chronic pain points toward new ways of caring for a condition affecting many Canadians.
local.whyItMatters: Chronic pain is common in every church; this may help Kris think pastorally about suffering, hope, and support for those living with invisible burdens.

local.title: RCMP Musical Ride coming to Chilliwack Heritage Park
local.summary: The Fraser Valley Current highlighted the upcoming RCMP Musical Ride at Chilliwack Heritage Park on August 28 as a notable community event.
local.whyItMatters: Community gatherings create natural opportunities for local presence, connection, and relational ministry beyond Sunday services.

persecutedChurch.title: Open Doors raises alarm over violence in Sudan
persecutedChurch.summary: Open Doors reports renewed violence against Christians in Sudan’s Nuba Mountains, including killings, abductions, and attacks affecting church leaders and worshippers.
persecutedChurch.whyItMatters: This is a clear call to informed prayer and solidarity with believers facing fear, displacement, and targeted violence.

persecutedChurch.title: Britain must do more for the persecuted church
persecutedChurch.summary: A new commentary argues that anti-Christian persecution remains a major global blind spot, highlighting cases like Pakistani Christian Maira Shahbaz and broader failures to respond.
persecutedChurch.whyItMatters: It can help pastors keep religious freedom and the suffering church visible in prayer, teaching, and advocacy.

leadership.title: Trust Drives Sustained Performance in Leadership
leadership.summary: This leadership reflection argues that strong results do not last without trust, and that transparency, consistency, listening, and accountability are what make leadership durable.
leadership.whyItMatters: Helpful for shaping church culture: trust multiplies ministry health, especially when decisions are difficult or pressure is high.

goodNews.title: Fraser Valley athletes score medals at Special Olympics Canada Summer Games
goodNews.summary: Fraser Valley athletes brought home a strong medal haul for Team BC, with local competitors from Abbotsford and Chilliwack earning gold, silver, and bronze.
goodNews.whyItMatters: This is a joyful local story of perseverance, dignity, and celebration that can encourage a congregation and honor community achievement.
